note: Class TN = round((subclass stat 1 + subclass stat 2) / 2). legacyIndex = position used by v0.8 files.

classes.name: Soldier
classes.summary: Front-line powerhouse built for dynamic positioning, combo-driven combat, and high-risk offensive plays.

resources.stanceNote: Decision 88: every combat starts in Ready (×1, no bonus). Only stance abilities change the stance; a normal attack (or Aim before one) keeps it; any other action (move, reload, swap, interact, use an item, a talent…) drops it to Ready — Tactical Points stay. The stance lasts through the enemies' turns and into your next turn until such an action. Attack: +2 TN on weapon attacks.

subclasses.name: Grunt
subclasses.desc: Front-line brawler: armor reduction, close-range devastation, aggressive Onslaught attacks.

subclasses.name: Officer
subclasses.desc: Tactical commander: squad positioning, defensive holds, marking priority targets.

classes.name: Hacker
classes.summary: Information warfare specialist balancing RAM and thermal strain to manipulate enemy networks remotely.

rules.ramFull: No RAM left: release a sustained payload (its ✕, Release all, or System Hard Reboot) to free slots.
rules.heatCap: Heat reaching the deck cap = Blue Screen: every sustained hack crashes (RAM freed), the deck is locked for the next round, then reboots at cap - 3 heat.
rules.range: Hack range: a device in sight, or within 10 squares on a network you have pinged.
rules.tags: Enemies are organic, cybernetic or synthetic. Most hacks only touch cybernetic or synthetic targets; organic ones are reached only through their gear.
rules.auto: Thermal Dump and System Hard Reboot need no roll and never take a slot; they still take an action.

subclasses.name: Scammer
subclasses.desc: Social engineering, credential spoofing, target distraction, low-cost sustained debuffs.

subclasses.name: Master
subclasses.desc: Heavy system destruction, deep network control, multi-target payloads, extreme heat.

classes.name: TechWiz
classes.summary: Battlefield architect controlling engagement flow through spatial manipulation, armor repair, and environmental control.

modes.name: Mend
modes.desc: Support face: repair, heal, cover, buff.

modes.name: Surge
modes.desc: Offensive face: strip armor, shock, traps, turrets.

rules.gain: +1 Sync each time you use an ability, and +1 at the end of a round in which you did not switch mode (max 3, Resonant).
rules.switch: Switching mode is free at the start of your turn, but Sync drops to 0.
rules.resonant: At Resonant (3) you may make a Resonant burst: the ability fires both faces, then Sync drops to 0.
rules.brownout: The heaviest abilities cause a Brownout: Sync 0 and the rig is offline (no abilities) until the end of the next round.

subclasses.name: Mechanic
subclasses.desc: Field fortification, armor patching, scrap fabrication.

subclasses.name: Engineer
subclasses.desc: Weapon modifications, electrical traps, automated hardware.

classes.name: Smuggler
classes.summary: High-speed opportunist thriving on chaos, momentum, and high-stakes black-market gambles.

subclasses.name: Dealer
subclasses.desc: Agile gunman and trickster: quick-draw strikes, black-market ammo, close-range robbery.

subclasses.name: Trafficker
subclasses.desc: Tactical mastermind and off-grid navigator: map control, decoys, underground favors.

classes.name: Scavenger
classes.summary: Patient reader of the fight: studies the dangerous target, then cashes in everything it learned at once, or takes what the enemy carries.

rules.gain: At the start of each of your turns, place 1 Tell on an enemy you can see within your optic's range; 2 if you are in full cover or in the dark and did not attack last round (Unseen).
rules.cap: At most 3 Tells on one enemy, and only as many enemies hold your Tells as your optic can Track.
rules.lost: Tells on an enemy are lost when it goes down, or at the end of a round in which you lost sight of it.
rules.exploit: Exploit (always on): when you hit an enemy, spend any of its Tells for +1d4 damage each.
rules.salvage: Salvage (always on): after a fight, take one extra item from what the enemies dropped (Liftable list).

modes.name: Thermal
modes.desc: Place Tells through smoke, darkness and partial cover.

modes.name: Motion
modes.desc: Once per turn, an enemy that moved since your last turn gets +1 Tell when you place one on it.

modes.name: Long-glass
modes.desc: Your optic's range doubles while you are in full cover.

modes.name: Pattern
modes.desc: Tells are never lost to line of sight, only when the target goes down.

liftable.yes: A magazine; consumables (stims, medkits, grenades); small tools; keycards, data chips and creds; civilian or junk weapons (knives, junk pistols).
liftable.locked: Military and corporate weapons are biometric-locked: in unauthorised hands they brick. Strip can disarm them, never make them yours.
liftable.never: Worn armor, cyberware, or anything on a synthetic or drone.

subclasses.name: Prowler
subclasses.desc: Close and quick-handed: reads an enemy face to face, lifts what it carries, jams its gun and strips its plates.

subclasses.name: Stalker
subclasses.desc: Patient eye at a distance: cases the room through the optic, marks targets for the crew, makes the shot that matters.

abilityRoll.note: Every ability rolls d20 against Class TN (minus GM difficulty). onFailure 'step' (decision 179): a failed roll spends the action and costs one step of the engine — 1 TP, 1 heat, 1 Tell on the target, Sync −1, or the pendulum one step toward 0; never the full price, and a builder builds nothing. 'spend': the full engine cost anyway (old rule). 'nothing': only the action.
